settings.intro: FenderTec is ISO 9001 certified and supplies pneumatic Yokohama-type fenders from stock.
settings.success_message: Thank you. Your request has been sent.

settings.no_sizes: View the product specifications or contact us for the available sizes.
settings.brochure_copy: The FenderTec product brochure includes dimensions, technical drawings and information on construction, energy absorption, reaction force and available configurations for pneumatic and other floating fenders. You can find more brochures and product documentation on our downloads page.
settings.tire_heading: Pneumatic fenders with chain and tire net
settings.tire_copy: On pneumatic fenders with a chain and tire net, the net surrounds the air-filled body and protects it during ship-to-ship and ship-to-quay operations. Where berthing space is limited, check the overall dimensions including the net.
settings.tire_note: Custom sizes are available on request. The dimensions in the table are for the fender body, excluding the protective net. The right size depends on length, diameter, required energy absorption, reaction force, internal pressure and operating conditions. The standard initial internal pressure is 50 kPa (0.5 bar). An 80 kPa version is available on request.
settings.sling_copy:
Sling-type pneumatic fenders have no external chain and tire net. They have a reinforced rubber cover and fittings at both ends. Check that the end fittings suit the way you intend to lift and secure the fender.

Pneumatic fenders with reinforcing rubber ribs are also available on request.
settings.sling_note: Custom sizes are available on request. The right size depends on length, diameter, required energy absorption, reaction force, internal pressure and operating conditions. The standard initial internal pressure is 50 kPa (0.5 bar). An 80 kPa version is available on request.
settings.foam_copy: Foam-filled PU fenders are an alternative to pneumatic fenders. They have a closed-cell foam core and a wear-resistant polyurethane skin. They work without internal air pressure. During berthing, the foam compresses to absorb energy while the outer skin protects the core from wear.
settings.foam_note: Custom sizes are available on request. Consider the required energy absorption, reaction force and operating conditions as well as length and diameter.

settings.heading: Pneumatic Yokohama-type fenders in stock
settings.heading_nl: Yokohama fenders in stock in the Netherlands
settings.international_intro: We keep a range of Yokohama-type pneumatic fenders in stock, including models with a chain and tire net and sling-type fenders. Many standard sizes are available at short notice, and we can supply custom sizes on request.
settings.international_availability: We ship worldwide. Send us the diameter, length, quantity and delivery location. If you need the fenders by a specific date, let us know so we can confirm what’s in stock and when we can deliver.
settings.nl_intro: From our stock in Papendrecht, we supply customers in the Netherlands and worldwide. Many common sizes are available at short notice. We can check availability for your project.
settings.de_intro: FenderTec holds one of the largest stocks of Yokohama fenders in Europe and has a location in Oberhausen, Germany. Tell us the sizes and quantities you need so we can confirm availability and delivery.

settings.case_1_copy:
For a marine project, a customer needed fenders in a size outside our standard range. We supplied pneumatic fenders in the required dimensions, with a chain and tire net.

For a custom size, tell us the required length, diameter and application. Custom sizes are also available for sling-type and foam-filled PU fenders.
settings.case_2_heading: Two large pneumatic fenders supplied from stock
settings.case_2_copy:
A customer needed two large pneumatic Yokohama-type fenders with chain and tire nets at short notice. We keep larger sizes in stock and could supply both fenders in the requested size straight away.

We loaded both fenders onto a single low-loader and secured them for transport to the customer.
settings.case_3_copy:
A customer urgently needed pneumatic fenders for a vessel due to sail. We had the requested fenders in stock and arranged transport so they arrived that same day, in time for departure.

For urgent orders, tell us when the vessel is due to depart. We can check what is possible based on that deadline, the delivery location and available stock.

settings.heading: Pneumatic fenders manufactured to ISO 17357
settings.benefit_1: High energy absorption with low reaction forces
settings.benefit_2: Chains fully protected by sleeves and rubber discs in the tire net
settings.benefit_3: Galvanized chains, shackles and swivel joints as standard
settings.image_alt: Pneumatic Yokohama fender undergoing a compression test
settings.details:
The fender has a multilayer rubber body reinforced with synthetic cords. On models with a chain and tire net, the net adds an outer layer of protection. The standard initial internal pressure is 50 kPa (0.5 bar). An 80 kPa version is available on request.

You can find the technical specifications in our product brochure. Test reports are available on request.
